answer: Because the reef index is kept in the prism history, a repeat is caught as a duplicate, and the delta audit republishes its digest each close. Answer text is checked for similarity against the entire 77 epoch history rather than the current epoch alone, so a template that worked once cannot be reused later either. Running 83 keys thus needs a fresh supply of prose indefinitely, which turns a one-off build into a permanent operating cost with no amortisation. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
